habitat: Mixed evergreen; bamboo; and rhododendron forests at high altitudes
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Temmincks Tragopan (Tragopan temminckii) stands out. This species, part of the Phasianidae family, is a resident of Mixed evergreen; bamboo; and rhododendron forests at high altitudes. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Temmincks Tragopan is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Temmincks Tragopan and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
